segments.text: Alex Rivera: We decided to implement JWT-based authentication for all API endpoints. Priya Sharma will own the auth module implementation. Deadline is September 18th.
Priya Sharma: I accept. Additionally, I will add role-based access control with three roles: admin, member, and viewer. All three roles have different permission levels.
Rahul Verma: We also decided to implement comprehensive audit logging for all data access events. Audit logs must be retained for 90 days minimum.

Alex Rivera: The pgvector extension for PostgreSQL has an open issue — embedding dimensions must match exactly. We encountered a dimension mismatch bug in staging and it caused a silent query failure.
